summary: ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, so the boot migration can be lock-timed-out by the outgoing replica. LOUD AND SELF-LIMITING -- a container restart is the natural retry, and the ALTER itself is instantaneous on a populated table (PG fast-default; new rows correctly read back ''), so only lock ACQUISITION is at risk, not a rewrite. Non-blocking, but this is the first DDL on the hottest table in a while and warrants a line of upgrade guidance.
